name: google-maps/reviews
description: Get Google Maps reviews for one place with sorting, filtering, and paging.

hl.description: Language for review labels and place context. Default 'en'.

num.description: Number of reviews: 1-100 on an unfiltered first request, 1-20 on filtered or continuation requests. Default 8.

query.description: Only reviews matching this free-text query. Cannot be combined with topic_id.

data_id.description: Hexadecimal Maps feature ID in the form '0x123:0x456'. Required unless place_id is supplied.

place_id.description: Google place ID of the business. Required unless data_id is supplied.

topic_id.description: Only reviews under this topic from the topics group. Cannot be combined with query.

next_page_token.description: Continuation token from pagination.next_page_token, passed back unchanged.

source_metadata.description: Include review-provider icon and scale metadata when available.

readme:
# Google Maps Reviews

Get Google Maps reviews for one place with sorting, filtering, and paging.
